backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the social app backend with posts, comments, messaging, notifications, follows, and user profiles, using access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three branding features (replacing logo images with a text-only 'Smileup' wordmark in TopBar.tsx, LandingPage.tsx, and App.tsx) to their affected files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the project's frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file with Tailwind directives and OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Smileup' and mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in theme, identity, and query providers, showing a gradient 'Smileup' splash during initialization, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, and the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to gradient initials, supporting multiple sizes and both legacy and new prop names.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), hiding on the ShortSport route and showing a dot indicator on Messages when conversations exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom-sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: Panel component for managing audio tracks in the editor, supporting file upload, recording toggle, per-track volume/mute controls, and track removal.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: Panel for configuring canvas design settings including aspect ratio selection, solid color backgrounds, and gradient presets applied to the first clip.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: Canvas component that renders the current video frame using the HTML5 Canvas API, drawing clip backgrounds, text layers, stickers, filters, vignette, glitch, and letterbox effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: Timeline component displaying a scrollable ruler, video clip track with scrubbing support, clip removal, and the ability to add blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: Panel for toggling a set of predefined motion graphic effects (e.g., glitch, confetti, letterbox) on the editor state, with an active effects summary display.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: Panel for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a local object URL.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: React panel component for applying image/video filter presets (e.g., Moody, Noir, Cinematic) and manually adjusting individual filter settings like brightness, contrast, saturation, and vignette via sliders.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: React panel component for browsing emoji stickers by category, adding them as timed layers to the editor, and adjusting selected sticker properties like size, rotation, and duration.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: React panel component for adding and editing text layers in the editor, with controls for font, size, color, alignment, bold/italic, animation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: React panel component that displays a library of video transitions (fade, slide, zoom, etc.) and allows applying them between consecutive clips in the editor timeline.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, a router Outlet, and a BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follow and message types) with read/unread state and navigation on click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a single post with author info, media, like/comment/view actions, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, a notification bell with unread badge, and a sign-out button on the profile page.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A UI card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, like/bookmark/share actions, follow button, and a double-tap like animation using mock data types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and context provider that manages Internet Identity authentication state, exposing login/logout functions, identity, and login status via an AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, posts, comments, notifications, and messages via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static mock data arrays for posts, comments, users, messages, and conversations used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for class name merging (cn), number formatting (K/M), time formatting, and relative time display (timeAgo).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for media, caption entry, and submission via the createPost mutation.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page with panel-based tools (filters, effects, stickers, design, export) and shared editor state types including clips, text layers, audio tracks, and filter settings.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a sticky search bar and tabs to browse/filter all posts or search users by handle, with debounced query and navigation to user profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page that fetches and displays all posts as PostCard components, with a comments sheet that opens when a post's comment button is clicked.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing/login page for the Smileup app featuring a gradient wordmark, tagline, Internet Identity login button, and feature highlights.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging page with a conversation list sidebar and a chat thread view, supporting text messages and shared post previews with unread counts and mark-as-read functionality.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing avatar, follower/following counts, a post grid, and an editable profile form (handle, display name, bio, profile picture) with authentication gating.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: Vertical short-video reel page that filters video posts, uses IntersectionObserver to auto-play the visible reel, and supports mute toggle and optimistic like actions.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: React page component that displays a user's profile (by handle or principal), including their posts in a grid, follower/following counts, and follow/unfollow actions with a comments sheet overlay.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the frontend, mapping URL paths to page components including feed, explore, profile, messages, and user profile routes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radius, box shadow, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for the Smileup app, recording completed features (text-only wordmark replacing logo images in TopBar, LandingPage, and App.tsx) and architectural notes about the black-background design.
